llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must wrap the form screen with `KeyboardProvider` and render form content in `KeyboardAwareScrollView` from `react-native-keyboard-controller`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: App wraps FormScreen with KeyboardProvider and renders form fields inside KeyboardAwareScrollView, both imported from react-native-keyboard-controller.
KeyboardAwareScrollView does not set keyboardDismissMode='interactive'; only bottomOffset and contentContainerStyle props are present.
KeyboardAwareScrollView does not set keyboardShouldPersistTaps='handled'; the prop is absent.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must use `useReanimatedKeyboardAnimation` with Reanimated `useAnimatedStyle` to drive footer `translateY` from `-keyboard.height.value`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Footer translateY is driven via useKeyboardHandler (event.height), not via useReanimatedKeyboardAnimation with keyboard.height.value as required.
evidence: useReanimatedKeyboardAnimation is never imported or called

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must use Reanimated `interpolate` over `keyboard.progress.value` to animate footer bottom padding during keyboard transitions.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No interpolate call over keyboard.progress.value exists; there is no animated bottom padding on the footer at all.
evidence: footerAnimatedStyle only sets transform translateY; no paddingBottom animation
interpolate is never imported or used
